parameters.note: Washeshu Creek (formerly Squaw Creek; renamed by the USGS in 2022) is a tributary of the Truckee River, which it joins near Olympic Valley, Placer Co. It is NOT a Lake Tahoe tributary, so the §7.50(b)(152) Lake Tahoe tributary closure does not apply. It is not listed by its own name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), and the main-stem Truckee River special regulation §7.50(b)(154) is reach-specific and contains no 'and tributaries' clause, so it does not reach this creek either. Washeshu Creek therefore falls under the general statewide stream regulation §5.85(a)(2): open with a five-trout bag from the last Saturday in April through November 15, then a zero-trout catch-and-release period with a barbless-artificial-lures gear restriction from November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April.

end.verbatim: the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April

candidates.summary: Open the last Saturday in April through November 15 (general statewide stream regulation; a Truckee River tributary not covered by any special listing); November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April is a zero-trout, artificial-lures-with-barbless-hooks period
